title: ARIA scrubber semantics, localized timing, and high-contrast micro-interactions for compact cost explorer
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Background: The compact cost explorer (metric scrubber used in Route Cost and Rollouts timelines) has several small interactive touchpoints that are currently inaccessible to screen reader users and fragile across locales. We’ve observed two classes of issues during recent audits: (1) the scrubber’s numeric updates are not announced consistently when keyboard focus or hover updates the scrubber, and (2) the interaction timing and microcopy assume English pluralization and short time units, causing awkward pacing and truncation for locales with longer strings (e.g., fr_FR, ja_JP) and for number formats with non‑Latin numerals. Scope: This ticket drives a design spec and prototype for: - Clear ARIA live semantics for the scrubber so value changes are announced predictably without excessive verbosity. - Keyboard-only scrub interactions (arrow key step, page step, home/end) with a visible focus ring and persistent accessible name. - Hover/focus high-contrast states that meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) or AA Enhanced (7:1) for important foreground/background combinations on the compact layout. - Locale-aware timing and microcopy: longer time labels, translated units, and reduced animation durations for languages where text length expands >20%. - Reduced-motion preference respect (prefers-reduced-motion) so scrubbing moves to instant transitions for motion-sensitive users. Deliverables: a Figma prototype with keyboard flows, an annotated spec in Confluence with acceptance criteria, updated token mapping for contrast states, a small demo on staging console, and engineering handoff notes with aria attributes and timing constants. Rationale and trade-offs: We intentionally use a polite ARIA live region (aria-live="polite") with a short summarized announcement rather than speaking every intermediate value during continuous scrubbing. Continuous announcements were too noisy in user testing. We also propose exposing a configuration flag in the component API (announceMode: "final" | "continuous") defaulting to "final" to let product teams choose when the scrubber should only announce the final value after a pause. This keeps runtime overhead low and provides predictable screenreader UX. Design decisions are documented below.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard-only users can move scrubber by arrow keys (small increment), page up/down (large increment), and home/end; focus ring visible and matches design tokens.
Screen readers (VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS) receive a concise announcement on value change: 'Cost scope: $1,240 — March 11 to March 17' with locale-aware number/date formatting.
Hover and focus contrast ratios for foreground text and interactive backgrounds meet at least WCAG AA 4.5:1 in the compact density across light and dark themes.
Locale expansions (tested with fr_FR, de_DE, ja_JP, ar_SA) do not cause truncation or overlap in the compact layout; animation durations reduce by 30% when localized text length > 20%.
prefers-reduced-motion respected so scrubbing results in no animated transitions; visual state still updates instantly and announcement occurs.
Engineering sign-off with a small staging demo URL and a linked PR implementing aria attributes, announceMode flag, and updated CSS tokens.
comments: 2026-02-28 Priya Kapoor: Initial ticket created after exploratory a11y audit. Included notes from QA pairing session (VoiceOver + ChromeVox).
2026-03-02 Maya Chen: Uploaded initial Figma prototype — added keyboard nav flows and focus ring token mapping. Requesting review from Eng for announceMode API design.
2026-03-04 Tomas Erickson (Engineering): Confirmed aria-live="polite" approach and proposed debounce timer of 500ms before final announcement. Raised question about telemetry for announceMode usage.
2026-03-06 Elena Morales (PM): Suggest including a brief in-product microcopy for non-English locales to explain scrub behavior on first-run; flagged localization effort.

2026-03-08 Accessibility review (external consultant): Tested VoiceOver & NVDA. Recommend moving announcement to role="status" region with aria-atomic=true for consistent reads on Safari. Also recommended contrast token update for danger/alert states.

2026-03-10 Maya Chen: Updated spec to use aria-live="polite" on a dedicated region with aria-atomic=false for continuous updates and a final announcement using aria-atomic=true when announceMode="final". Filed PR and linked above. Ready for design review.
review_notes: PM note (Elena Morales): Good balance between fidelity and verbosity. Please ensure localization team can supply longer translations ahead of the rollout window.
Engineering note (Tomas Erickson): Implementation plan ok; will expose announceMode in component props and add telemetry opt-in. Need to pick a constants file for debounce timings.
A11y consultant: Prefer semantic region with role="status" for Safari/VoiceOver; ensure we test with NVDA+Firefox for parity. Provide test matrix in Confluence.
Localization lead (Akiko Suzuki): Request a JSON file with sample expanded strings for FR/DE/JP/AR so we can baseline layout changes; provide guidance on pluralization rules.
decision_log: 2026-03-05: Chose aria-live="polite" with a configurable announceMode for final vs continuous announcements (default: final).
2026-03-08: Use role="status" wrapper region to maximize compatibility across screen readers; engineering to implement aria-atomic toggling as part of announceMode implementation.
2026-03-09: Contrast thresholds set to 4.5:1 for regular elements and 7:1 for emphasized state (token mapping updated).
next_steps: 1) Localization team to produce expanded translations sample by 2026-03-12. 2) Engineering to land PR and deploy demo to staging (PR #8142) and run CI a11y tests (axe + pa11y). 3) Design to run a 30-minute usability check with screen-reader users on staging and capture qualitative notes. 4) Final sign-off from A11y consultant and Localization lead before merge to release branch.
handoff_notes: Engineering checklist: - Implement announceMode prop ("final" | "continuous") defaulting to "final". - Add aria-live/role="status" region and toggle aria-atomic per announceMode. - Debounce final announcement at 500ms (configurable token). - Respect prefers-reduced-motion by skipping CSS transitions on scrubbing. - Use Intl.NumberFormat and Intl.DateTimeFormat for all announced strings (locale passed from top-level). - Add telemetry event 'scrubber_announce_mode' when announceMode explicitly set by product teams. See Confluence spec for markup examples and test matrix.
